items.title: AmnesiaStealer Gives Hackers Hidden Control of Logged-In Browsers on Macs
items.description: AmnesiaStealer is a newly identified macOS information stealer that does more than copy saved passwords. It can give criminals quiet control of a browser that is already signed in, turning an infected Mac into a gateway to email, business apps, cryptocurrency services, and other accounts without alerting the user.
